adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`, each provided username is looked up and blindly passed to `group.add(user)` without checking whether the user is already a member (no `include?`/`exists?` guard, no rescue). Given the common presence of a unique constraint on the join table, this pattern can surface as a `RecordNotUnique`/500 when re-adding an existing member. The diff also makes re-submission more likely (JS action notes the input is not cleared: `// TODO: should clear the input`). While the exact uniqueness constraint/`Group#add` implementation isn’t shown in the diff, the lack of idempotency handling in the new endpoint is verifiable here.
